programmes.d: A revisited cut of this lost film follows a group of friends with one of their own missing, traveling to the remote Florida Everglades where they discover that an ancient, malevolent curse is tracking them.
Jack travels to France on the trail of a cursed tome, Lucifer's Bible. The town is a holy site, with a fountain that cures the sick and dying. However, a priest of Satan, Asteroth, has the Bible.
Micki and Ryan get word of Jack's injury at the end of the preceding episode. They travel to Marie-Mere with Johnny Ventura to investigate and try to recover Lucifer's Bible.
A woman (Mischa Barton) reeling from the death of her parents becomes attached to an alluring man whose sudden disappearance sends her and her friends into a haunted high-rise to find him.

programmes.t: The Return of the Living Dead
programmes.d: Two employees of a medical supply company accidentally release a toxic gas that raises up the dead. Soon the town is overrun with flesh-eating residents of the local cemetery who are hungry for human brains.
Freddie Lounds finds Beverly's sectioned corpse; Will meets the copycat killer and orders him to kill Hannibal. Gideon overhears this and gives Alana the chance to save Will from becoming a murderer.
A city councilman's body is found intertwined with a tree; Jack crashes Hannibal's dinner party to investigate Will's suspicions; a revelation shocks everyone.

Trolls live in the woods around Nibog and feed on the town's population. By transforming themselves into people, the trolls are able to come into town and pick their menu.
A close-knit family, the Cassidys, had a daughter who was kidnapped by a cult of demon worshippers, and track the demon to a secret cavern beneath Curious Goods that the cult uses for its rituals.
Fleeing fraternity boys who plan to attack her, a figure skater is hit by a car and crippled. However, a mysterious old man sells her an antique wheelchair at a garage sale.
A bizarre series of sudden disappearances on the streets of New York City seems to point toward something unsavory living in the sewers.
A ghostly presence and a lawyer come between four young siblings. They must stand together or be torn apart.
